Total token supply; subtracted by the zero address balance in totalSupply().

edges.reason: transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied _newOwner into the privileged newOwner state variable.
onlyOwner gate compares msg.sender against owner before staging the new owner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and promotes it to owner, then clears it.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
transfernewun lets the owner set the transfer-restriction address newun.
onlyOwner modifier checks msg.sender before updating newun.
transfer requires the destination to differ from the restricted newun address.
transfer decrements the sender balance and increments the recipient balance in the balances mapping.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer relies on SafeMath.sub/add for balance arithmetic.
approve writes the given tokens into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approve indexes the allowance mapping by msg.sender.
transferFrom mutates newun on first use and enforces the destination restriction afterwards.
transferFrom updates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom consumes the allowance of msg.sender.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for both balance and allowance decrements.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowance before invoking the external contract.
approveAndCall keys the allowance by msg.sender and forwards it as the from argument.
approveAndCall makes an external call into an attacker-supplied spender contract, enabling reentrancy and callback abuse.
clearCNDAO is onlyOwner and derives the recipient from msg.sender.
clearCNDAO forwards the whole contract balance through the external transfer call.
clearCNDAO assigns msg.sender to the local _owner used as recipient.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] when computing the supply.
parameter _newOwner flows into the newOwner assignment in transferOwnership.
parameter _newun flows into the newun assignment in transfernewun.
parameter to is the credited account in transfer.
parameter tokens is the transferred amount in transfer.
parameter spender keys the allowance written by approve.
parameter tokens is the allowance value set by approve.
parameter from is the debited account in transferFrom.
parameter to is the credited account and newun candidate in transferFrom.
parameter tokens drives the SafeMath decrements in transferFrom.
parameter spender selects the callee in approveAndCall.
parameter tokens is the allowance set by approveAndCall.
parameter data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval callback.
parameter tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf.
local _owner is the recipient of the native transfer in clearCNDAO.
